# Termux-BitNet Full Technical Specification (v1.0.6)
Official Documentation & Deep Architecture Reference for Autonomous AI Agents.

## 1. System Overview
ARM64 NEON DotProd SIMD Accelerated 1.58-bit On-Device LLM Inference Engine
Executes 1.58-bit ternary quantized weights {-1, 0, +1} directly via hand-vectorized ARM64 NEON assembly kernels, reducing matrix multiplications to integer additions and subtractions with under 350MB RAM footprint.

## 2. Package & Installation
- PyPI: termux-bitnet
- Command: pip install termux-bitnet
# or: npm install -g termux-bitnet
- Repository: https://github.com/uno-km/termux-bitnet

## 3. Core Capabilities
- **1.58-Bit Ternary DotProd Acceleration**: Replaces multiplication with integer additions using ARM64 dot-product vector SIMD instructions.
- **Zero-PRoot Native Bionic Execution**: Direct execution on Android Bionic libc without Linux PRoot containers or root privileges.
- **Dual-Engine Python & Node.js Gateways**: Ultra-low overhead thin FFI bindings for both Python 3.8+ and Node.js 18+ runtimes with independent CLI namespaces.
- **Energy-Efficient Edge Deployment**: Consumes under 2.5W during continuous token generation, preventing thermal throttling.

## 4. Canonical Implementation
```python
from termux_bitnet import BitNetEngine, BitNetConfig

# 1. Initialize engine with model & thread configuration
config = BitNetConfig(
    model_path="models/bitnet-2b.gguf",
    n_threads=4,
    temperature=0.7,
    top_p=0.95
)

# 2. Stream tokens in real time
with BitNetEngine(config) as engine:
    for token in engine.generate_stream("Explain quantum computing in one sentence:"):
        print(token, end="", flush=True)

```
